records.jp: ふむ……まだまだ不可解なことが多いな……
records.en_original: Hmm... There's so much I can't yet explain...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. There's so much I can't yet explain.
records.en: Hmm... There's so much I can't yet explain...

records.jp: 有理？　どうかしたの？
records.en_original: Yuri? What're you up to?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri? What're you up to?
records.en: Yuri? What're you up to?

records.jp: ……ああ、君か
records.en_original: ...Ah, it's you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Ah, it's you.
records.en: ...Ah, it's you.

records.jp: この間、私が自分の感情に気づいたことで、<CR>私からもフラグメントが出てきただろう？
records.en_original: You remember how recognizing that I had fragments allowed me to form a Fragment, yes?
records.en_auxiliary: You remember how being aware of my feelings allowed me to form a Fragment?
records.en: You remember how recognizing that I had fragments allowed me to form a Fragment, yes?

records.jp: しかし、感情というものを完全に理解できたわけではない。<CR>考えてみれば、よくわからないことばかりだ
records.en_original: I still don't fully understand those feelings. In fact, the more I think about them, the more I recognize my ignorance.
records.en_auxiliary: I still don't fully understand those feelings. In fact, the more I think about them, the more I recognize my ignorance.
records.en: I still don't fully understand those feelings. In fact, the more I think about them, the more I recognize my ignorance.

records.jp: 感情、かぁ……<CR>完全に理解できてる人なんていないかもね
records.en_original: Honestly, I don't think anyone fully understands their feelings
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, I don't think anyone fully understands their feelings.
records.en: Honestly, I don't think anyone fully understands their feelings

records.jp: 色んな感情が混ざると自分でもよくわからなくなるし、<CR>わかっていても感情を抑えられるとは限らないから
records.en_original: When lots of feelings mix together, its hard to tell how you feel, and knowing isn't necessarily enough to control them.
records.en_auxiliary: When lots of feelings mix together, it's hard to tell how you feel, and recognizing emotion isn't always enough to control it.
records.en: When lots of feelings mix together, its hard to tell how you feel, and knowing isn't necessarily enough to control them.

records.jp: ……いや、感情の発現はこの世界で起きている事象なのだから、<CR>理解できないということなどあり得ない
records.en_original: ...That's unsatisfactory. Emotions are a worldly phenomenon and, by extension, should be understandable.
records.en_auxiliary: That's unsatisfactory. Emotions are a worldly phenomenon and should therefore be able to be fully understood.
records.en: ...That's unsatisfactory. Emotions are a worldly phenomenon and, by extension, should be understandable.

records.jp: 脳が学習することで経験が蓄積され、新たな経験に対して脳が<CR>経験に基づいた信号を出し、感情を発現させるとすると……
records.en_original: The brain generates new responses based on past stimuli, so  if I can allow certain emotions to manifest...
records.en_auxiliary: The brain generates new responses based on past stimuli, so if I can allow certain emotions to manifest...
records.en: The brain generates new responses based on past stimuli, so  if I can allow certain emotions to manifest...

records.jp: ゆ、有理……？
records.en_original: Y-Yuri...?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-Yuri?
records.en: Y-Yuri...?

records.jp: ……ふむ。人の感情を理解するには、<CR>脳科学分野の研究を行うのが得策か……
records.en_original: ...Hm. It may be a good idea to research neuroscience to better understand human emotions...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. It may be a good idea to research neuroscience to better understand human emotions.
records.en: ...Hm. It may be a good idea to research neuroscience to better understand human emotions...

records.jp: ま、待って！？　研究するのも大事だけど、<CR>それってあくまで一般論とか仕組みがわかるだけでしょ？
records.en_original: Hold on for a second. Research may be important, but it will only give you a clinical explanation.
records.en_auxiliary: Hold on for a second. Research may be important, but it will only give you a clinical explanation.
records.en: Hold on for a second. Research may be important, but it will only give you a clinical explanation.

records.jp: 有理自身が感じてる“楽しい”とか“悲しい”って気持ちを<CR>理解するには、また別の方法が必要なんじゃないかな……
records.en_original: There has to be a better way to understand how emotions like joy and sorrow actually feel.
records.en_auxiliary: There has to be a better way to understand how emotions like joy and sorrow actually feel.
records.en: There has to be a better way to understand how emotions like joy and sorrow actually feel.

records.jp: ああ、それは一理あるな……。原種に関する研究もしなくては<CR>ならないし、今は違う分野に手を出す時間もなさそうだ
records.en_original: There may be truth to that... Besides, my Sephira research somewhat limits my time to delve into other fields.
records.en_auxiliary: There may be truth to that. Besides, my Sephira research somewhat limits my time to delve into other fields.
records.en: There may be truth to that... Besides, my Sephira research somewhat limits my time to delve into other fields.

records.jp: う、うん……。そうだね……
records.en_original: That makes sense.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah, I guess it would.
records.en: That makes sense.

records.jp: しかし、私自身の感情を理解する……か。<CR>どんな学問よりも難解に思えてくるな……
records.en_original: Still, understanding my own emotions seems more difficult than any other field of study...
records.en_auxiliary: Still, understanding my own emotions seems more difficult than any other field of study.
records.en: Still, understanding my own emotions seems more difficult than any other field of study...

records.jp: あはは……これまで真剣に考えたことはなかったけど、<CR>言われてみれば難しいよね……
records.en_original: Ahaha... I've never thought about it that seriously before, but now that you mention it...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! I've never thought about it that seriously before, but now that you mention it...
records.en: Ahaha... I've never thought about it that seriously before, but now that you mention it...

records.jp: そういえば……君はフラグメントを集めているんだったな。<CR>いわば、強い感情の塊とも呼べるものを
records.en_original: By the way... You were gathering Fragments, right? They could also be considered masses of powerful emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: So, um, you were gathering Fragments, right? They could also be considered masses of powerful emotions.
records.en: By the way... You were gathering Fragments, right? They could also be considered masses of powerful emotions.

records.jp: それなら君は、自分や相手の感情を理解する方法を<CR>既に心得ているのではないか？
records.en_original: Which would mean that you already know how to understand emotions, be they your own and others', correct?
records.en_auxiliary: Which would mean that you already know how to understand emotions, both your own and others', don't you think?
records.en: Which would mean that you already know how to understand emotions, be they your own and others', correct?

records.jp: そ、そうなのかな……？<CR>フラグメントの固定化って、結構感覚的だけど……
records.en_original: Y-You think so...? Stabilizing Fragments is mostly just intuition...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you think so? Stabilizing Fragments is mostly just intuition.
records.en: Y-You think so...? Stabilizing Fragments is mostly just intuition...

records.jp: その方法がわかれば、<CR>私も自らの感情を更に深く理解することができる
records.en_original: If I can learn your methods, I may be able to understand my own emotions on a deeper level as well.
records.en_auxiliary: If I can learn your methods, I may be able to understand my own emotions on a deeper level, as well.
records.en: If I can learn your methods, I may be able to understand my own emotions on a deeper level as well.

records.jp: 私のフラグメントもより強固なものになるだろうし、<CR>そうすれば君たちにとっても有益となるわけだが……
records.en_original: It would make my Fragment even more stable, which would in turn benefit you.
records.en_auxiliary: It would make my Fragment even more stable, which would in turn benefit you.
records.en: It would make my Fragment even more stable, which would in turn benefit you.

records.jp: 感情を理解する方法……か
records.en_original: Methods to understand emotions, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Means and methods to understanding emotions... Hmm.
records.en: Methods to understand emotions, huh...

records.jp: 色んな人と話をするのが一番じゃないかな。<CR>一緒に戦ってるみんな……とかさ
records.en_original: I think it would be best to talk to all kinds of people. For example, the girls we're fighting together with.
records.en_auxiliary: I think it would be best to talk to all kinds of people. For example, the girls we're fighting alongside.
records.en: I think it would be best to talk to all kinds of people. For example, the girls we're fighting together with.

records.jp: 話している相手が楽しそうかどうか考えてみるのも、<CR>いい刺激になるんじゃないかな
records.en_original: Thinking about whether the person you're talking to is having fun or not could be a good experiment for you.
records.en_auxiliary: Thinking about whether the person you're talking to is having fun or not could be a good experiment for you.
records.en: Thinking about whether the person you're talking to is having fun or not could be a good experiment for you.

records.jp: ……確かに、私はあまり他人と話をしないからな。<CR>他人がどのような感情を持っているかは興味深い
records.en_original: ...True. I don't talk with others very often. I'd be interested to know what kind of emotions they have.
records.en_auxiliary: True. I don't talk with others very often. I'd be interested to know what kind of emotions they have.
records.en: ...True. I don't talk with others very often. I'd be interested to know what kind of emotions they have.

records.jp: うん。感情って人それぞれだから、<CR>話してるうちに有理自身の感情も見えてくると思うよ
records.en_original: Yeah. Everyone has their own feelings, and I think you'll start to understand yourself better as you talk to them.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Everyone has their own feelings, and I think you'll start to understand yourself better as you talk to them.
records.en: Yeah. Everyone has their own feelings, and I think you'll start to understand yourself better as you talk to them.

records.jp: 他者を分析することで自己を相対化するわけか……
records.en_original: So you're saying I should analyze others and compare my findings with myself?
records.en_auxiliary: So you're saying I should analyze others and compare my findings with myself?
records.en: So you're saying I should analyze others and compare my findings with myself?

records.jp: 有意義なことを聞いた。<CR>今度実践してみるとしよう
records.en_original: That sounds worthwhile. I'll try putting it into practice sometime.
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds worthwhile. I'll try putting it into practice sometime.
records.en: That sounds worthwhile. I'll try putting it into practice sometime.

records.jp: あはは……分析や実践とか深く考えずに、<CR>自然に会話するのが一番かもしれないけどね……
records.en_original: Ahaha... Don't think of it as analysis. It's better to just talk naturally...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Don't think of it as analysis. It's better to try and be natural.
records.en: Ahaha... Don't think of it as analysis. It's better to just talk naturally...

records.jp: みんなと遊ぶのはどう？　みんなで楽しんでると、<CR>有理も楽しいって実感が湧いてくるんじゃないかな
records.en_original: How about having fun with everyone? If everyone around you is having fun, you might too.
records.en_auxiliary: How about having fun with everyone? If everyone around you is having fun, you might, too.
records.en: How about having fun with everyone? If everyone around you is having fun, you might too.

records.jp: 遊ぶ……遊ぶ、か……
records.en_original: Fun... Fun, you say...?
records.en_auxiliary: Fun? Did you say "fun"?
records.en: Fun... Fun, you say...?

records.jp: プライベートにおいてほとんど他人と関わらない<CR>私にとっては、感情を理解する以上の難関だな……
records.en_original: I hardly relate to the people in my private life. This "fun" sounds even more difficult than understanding emotions...
records.en_auxiliary: I hardly relate to the people in my private life. Dealing with "fun" sounds even more difficult than understanding emotions.
records.en: I hardly relate to the people in my private life. This "fun" sounds even more difficult than understanding emotions...

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ……
records.en_original: Y-You have a point...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you may have a point.
records.en: Y-You have a point...

records.jp: まあ、最初は色々話をして仲良くなるのがいいかもね。<CR>遊びに行くのはそれからってことで
records.en_original: Well, first you just have to talk about all kinds of things, and get to know people. You can have go have fun after that.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, first you just have to talk about all kinds of things and get to know people. You can go have fun after that.
records.en: Well, first you just have to talk about all kinds of things, and get to know people. You can have go have fun after that.

records.jp: 仲良くなる……か。そうだな、まずは相手の好みをリサーチし、<CR>適切な話題を持ちかけて、徐々に会話の頻度を上げ……
records.en_original: Understood. I'll start by researching topics of a subject's interest, then gradually increase conversational frequency.
records.en_auxiliary: Understood. I'll start by researching topics of a subject's interest, then gradually increase conversational frequency.
records.en: Understood. I'll start by researching topics of a subject's interest, then gradually increase conversational frequency.

records.jp: そ、そんなところまで計算しなくていいから！
records.en_original: I-It doesn't have to be that calculated!
records.en_auxiliary: I-it doesn't have to be that calculated!
records.en: I-It doesn't have to be that calculated!

records.jp: それなら――
records.en_original: Let me think...
records.en_auxiliary: Let me think...
records.en: Let me think...
